raw_text: Commercial satellite imagery has revealed enhanced training activity at a Pakistan Special Service Group facility in Kotli district of Pakistan-administered Kashmir, approximately 12 kilometres from the Line of Control. Analysis of Planet Labs captures from 19-21 January shows construction of temporary structures, increased vehicle traffic, and troop movements consistent with a battalion-level field exercise. The SSG is Pakistan Army's premier special operations force. Indian defence sources confirmed awareness of the activity.
clean_text: Janes confirms enhanced Pakistan SSG training at Kotli facility 12km from LoC via satellite imagery. Battalion-level exercise with temporary structures and troop movements.
